summary.text: Frank J. Smith represents Milford's 118th House District in the Connecticut General Assembly, first elected in 2020 and re-elected in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: He is a lifelong resident of Milford's West Shore area and a graduate of Milford Public Schools.
He was a Milford alderman from 1998 to 2001 and again from 2011 to 2021, and serves on the Environment, Education and Transportation committees.
